Part.name: Relikt ERA turret plate
Part.description: Placeable reactive armour plate with short-edge hinges. One plate reacts once against eligible HEAT or APFSDS hits. Up to 50% less remaining HEAT penetration and 15% less APFSDS penetration. About 31.3 kg. Place the closed plate facing outward; freely move, rotate and mirror. Return to Edit to restore. Gameplay calibration, not exact historical performance. Spent passive collision and mass remain; no tandem simulation.
